stamped-checklist:must/001.reason: All committed files sit beneath the study root; inputs, code and results are root-relative.

stamped-checklist:must/002.reason: The 54 maps and cohort metadata are inside input/; sources.json links back to their retrievable origins.

stamped-checklist:must/003.reason: Python packages imported by the group script are declared in the tracked Pixi environment.

stamped-checklist:must/004.reason: Git tracks code, text and configuration; the requested commit has a clean working tree.

stamped-checklist:must/005.reason: Git-annex carries the binary content; the probe found 55 annex pointers and no oversized Git binary.

stamped-checklist:must/006.reason: Derived results have no run record or tracked workflow linking them to the exact environment used.

stamped-checklist:must/007.reason: The commit has no README with install/use instructions or Makefile; the report is not either required entry document.

stamped-checklist:must/008.reason: The report gives a runnable Pixi command for scripts/group_analysis.py, a clear analysis starting point.

stamped-checklist:must/009.reason: The probe found no host-specific absolute paths in tracked text files.

stamped-checklist:must/010.reason: pixi.toml declares dependencies, but wildcard versions and the ignored, absent pixi.lock do not fix them.

stamped-checklist:must/011.reason: Pixi declares supported platforms; the report documents Pixi execution and network-fetched atlas/template inputs.

stamped-checklist:must/012.reason: The Pixi specification lists platform targets and the analysis package dependencies needed by the script.

stamped-checklist:must/013.reason: pixi.toml is committed alongside the analysis script and supplied data.

stamped-checklist:must/014.reason: No dependency update or lock regeneration process is documented; pixi.lock is ignored and absent.

stamped-checklist:should/001.reason: Code, metadata and annexed binary inputs share Git versioning; git-annex stores large content.
